title: Ravens players want this fourth quarter collapse to be a "hiccup," not a way of life

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens players want this fourth quarter collapse to be a "hiccup," not a way of life
sources.description: The Ravens held an 11-point lead over the Saints in the first half on Sunday and they were up by eight points heading into the fourth quarter, but two Saints touchdowns made New Orleans 24-17 winners in Baltimore when the final whistle sounded.
